title: Memory overflow in Packet Processing can lead to unpredictable or erroneous behavior or Denial of… (CVE-2026-120868)
description: A memory overflow vulnerability exists in the packet processing component of NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway. This flaw can cause unpredictable or erroneous behavior, including potential denial of service conditions. The vulnerability is critical with a CVSS 4.0 score of 9.3, indicating high impact and ease of exploitation without privileges or user interaction. No affected versions or patch information are provided, and no known exploits are reported in the wild.
